name: Graft
text:
Decision: We will build a single, shared "Memory Map" document that links every key idea to its meaning, its related ideas, and its real-world use. This map will be written in plain language, with no hidden jargon or code.

Why: A shared map lets us recall by meaning, not by rote. It connects ideas so the brain can build a graph, not a list. It also forces us to explain things simply, which uncovers gaps and embeds what was unembedded.

Trade-off: We accept slower initial writing for faster long-term recall. The map won’t be perfect at first, but it will grow clearer with use.
